value.rationale: The first two radial Walsh levels are canonical centered Krawtchouk degrees and a natural mixed-harmonic test space. The sharp mixed amplitude M_n strictly improves the pure homogeneous quadratic extremum and supplies a dimension-independent raw coefficient balance S +/- Q, a global exact rigidity deficit, a minimizing-mode transition n=2/3/4, and a Euclidean distortion peak n=3 followed by a golden-ratio limit. These facts are structurally motivated and are not arbitrary numerical slices.
